optimal_wave_order.rationale: Edge OpenSSL must support PQC key encapsulation and HSM hardware must be upgraded before any dependent microservices can negotiate or sign with PQC.
Auth microservice can safely issue dual-signed hybrid tokens once backend HSM supports ML-DSA.
Phased rollout to mobile client fleet with mandatory fallback to classical TLS 1.3 to avoid middlebox packet fragmentation outages.
